meta.title: The status endpoint rejects a submitted bid while bidding is open
gaps: The HTTP 200 status of the status endpoint response and that the response body is the bid are not directly asserted.
warnings: verify 1: read_bid's reply shape has not been sampled; "status" is unverified

words.preconditions: A fresh published RFQ event where the invited QA vendor has submitted a bid; bidding still open.
steps: The buyer sends the bid call, the request the case itself writes.
As the buyer, read the bid and check that Data check: “status” equals rejected.
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: Data check: “status” equals rejected.
